title: SEC3: Duplicate SQL upsert logic in contact.rs (upsert vs upsert_discovered_contact)
description: contact.rs lines 30-104: Two nearly identical upsert methods with only one semantic difference. upsert (30-63) unconditionally updates display_name, while upsert_discovered_contact (71-104) updates it only if NULL. Both share identical state advance/emit logic, nearly identical SQL structure, and only differ in parameter naming (display_name vs discovered_display_name). This 95% duplication creates maintenance risk — a bug fix in one may be missed in the other. Better: Consolidate to single upsert() with bool preserve_display_name parameter controlling CASE WHEN semantics. Reduces duplication, makes intent explicit, centralizes state/emit logic.
